how_it_works.intro_pre_link: Welcome to the Fresh Market buyer panel. This panel serves two purposes: reviewing
how_it_works.preconnect_li_1_text: In this section you receive submissions from suppliers matched to your retailer.
how_it_works.preconnect_li_2_text: You can open product details and check parameters, logistics, certificates and supporting materials.
how_it_works.preconnect_li_3_text: If a submission is interesting, you can save it for later review.
how_it_works.preconnect_li_4_text: Opening details means the submission has been read by the buyer.
how_it_works.fm_li_1_text: In this section you see companies that want to meet with your retailer during Fresh Market 2026.
how_it_works.fm_li_2_text_pre: You can mark a supplier as:
how_it_works.fm_li_3_text: Based on buyer decisions and supplier choices, the system prepares a proposed meeting schedule.
how_it_works.fm_li_4_text: The final meeting schedule will appear in the panel after the organiser confirms it.
how_it_works.help_text: If you have questions or notice incorrect data, contact the organiser via chat or the contact details in the panel.
